objective: Set up the amp on your pitch.
intro: Bellweather, last ferry of the evening.
Kit: One good set and I can pay Ione back for the tram fare.
lines: The amp hums awake.

objective: Walk to the quay edge and tune to the ferry horn.
lines: The ferry horn sounds a long, low A.
Kit: There it is. Everything on this island is in time with something.
Learned: Loose Change

objective: Play for the quay: hold F, release on the bright downbeat. Three clean bars.
lines: Coins ring in the guitar case.
Kit: Enough for breakfast. Tram stop in the morning.

effects.card: One More Beat|Punch Quay · the next morning

objective: Talk to Paz by the tram stop.
lines: Paz: These steps get taller every year, busker.
Paz: Walk me to the tram door? Slowly. I am not a ferry.

objective: Walk Paz to the tram door. Stay close.
lines: Paz: You keep good time. Most people only keep their own.

objective: Talk to Ione, the conductor.
lines: Ione: The lamp will not let the doors close until it hears its closing chord.
Ione: Hold it until the bar comes round, then let go. Like this.
Learned: Closing Call

objective: Play Closing Call into the tram lamp above the stop.
lines: The lamp folds from a circle into a bar. The doors sigh shut.
Ione: One more beat and we would have been late. Ride up to the market with us tonight.

objective: Find Mara at her stall.
lines: Mara: You are the one from the quay. Play me the closing one, before the lamps go.
Mara: My mother wound these clocks. Nobody asks them anything any more.

objective: Play Mara's request in the market square. Three clean bars.
lines: The whole market leans in on the last chord.
Then every lamp snaps to white. Shutters slam. Something is counting.
Mara: A raid. They are collecting the hours. Kit — my goggles!

objective: Grab Mara's goggles from the gutter.
lines: Through the lens the timetable peels back: wires, counters, a city being wound down.
Mara: Now you see it. The last tram is still at the quay. Go!

effects.card: Last Tram Out|Punch Quay · the raid

objective: Hold the tram doors: play Closing Call into the lamp.
intro: Ione: The lamp is locked open. It wants them counted, not carried!
lines: The doors hold. The passengers scatter up the steps.
Something heavy steps onto the platform.

objective: Shut down the Platform Collector. Keep your distance and land on-beat releases.
lines: The Collector's counter rolls to zero and stays there.

objective: Talk to Ione.
lines: Ione: Route key. Opens the service landing under the viaduct.
Ione: The Punch Clock down there stamps every hour they take. Wake it up wrong.

objective: Play Closing Call into the Punch Clock.
lines: Kit: Backstage. The whole city has a backstage.
Rank earned: Protector

effects.card: Market Under Glass|Switchback Market · shutters down

objective: Find Mara in the shuttered market.
lines: Mara: The shutters answer to a rising figure. My mother called it Shutter Rise.
Mara: Take it. And get Tolly and Wren out by the service stairs.
Learned: Shutter Rise

objective: Lead Tolly and Wren to the service stairs.
lines: Wren: The press is on the terrace above. That is where the counting comes from.
Tolly: Mind its champion. It hates a tune it cannot print.

effects.card: The Roll Press|the terrace above the market

objective: Out-play the Press Champion.
lines: The Champion jams on a bar it cannot finish.

objective: Play Shutter Rise into the Roll Press.
lines: Kit: A spare beat. One the timetable never counted.
Learned: Spare Beat
Rank earned: Defender

objective: Send the Spare Beat uphill: play it into the terrace relay.
lines: The beat jumps lamp to lamp, up the switchbacks.

objective: Catch the Spare Beat at the Crown relay and pass it on.
lines: The hill is holding one beat too many. The Lathe notices.

objective: Defeat Crown Zero.
intro: Crown Zero: COUNT INCOMPLETE. RETURN THE BEAT.
lines: Crown Zero: …one… more…
It winds down, mid-bar, and is only brass.

objective: Play the Spare Beat into the Crown Lathe.
lines: Mara: You gave them back a beat nobody owns.
Kit: Then it is everybody's. Same time tomorrow, on the quay.
Rank earned: City Hero
